fields.raw: // Business Profile (preenchido no onboarding; usado para buscas/IA)
// Onboarding: só acessa dashboard após concluir
// Suporte/admin podem desativar conta; login bloqueado quando preenchido
// Notification preferences (used when sending alert emails)
/** Billing cycle for current subscription: monthly or annual. Used for proration on upgrade. */
/** Downgrade scheduled for end of period: plan to apply at pendingPlanEffectiveAt */
pendingPlanId      String?   // PlanType key, e.g. BUSINESS
/** BR Starter promo (R$59 x 6 months) — set when trial expires or via email link */
/** When BR trial reactivation promo email was sent (dedup for cron/script). */
// Business profile (one per workspace; shared by all members)
/// Controla acesso ao módulo de Auto-Prospecção (ativado pelo admin do sistema)
dailyLeadsGoal         Int?  // target leads contacted per day
dailyAnalysesGoal      Int?  // target AI analyses per day
monthlyConversionsGoal Int?  // target conversions per month
// Credit limits per member (null = no individual cap, uses workspace pool)
dailyLeadsLimit   Int?  // max consumptions (search + analysis) per calendar day
weeklyLeadsLimit  Int?  // max consumptions in rolling 7 days
monthlyLeadsLimit Int?  // max consumptions per calendar month
/// Acesso ao módulo de Auto-Prospecção (ativado pelo owner da workspace)
inviter   User      fields: [invitedById], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
scoreFactors     Json?     // { noWebsite, fewReviews, lowRating, noPhone, ...
closeProbability         Int?           // 0-100% AI-predicted chance of closing
estimatedDealValue       Float?         // Estimated deal size in BRL
reclameAquiAnalysis      String?         // AI analysis of Reclame Aqui data
jusBrasilAnalysis        String?         // AI analysis of legal proceedings
cnpjAnalysis             String?         // AI analysis of CNPJ/RF data
dealValue                Float?         // Actual deal value (user fills on CONVERTED)
lostReason               String?        // PRICE | NO_NEED | COMPETITOR | NO_RESPONSE | OTHER
contactedAt              DateTime?      // When status changed to CONTACTED
convertedAt              DateTime?      // When status changed to CONVERTED
lostAt                   DateTime?      // When status changed to LOST
filters      Json?    // hasWebsite, hasPhone, includedType, etc.
resultsData  Json?    // Array of places returned from search, for history detail view
quantity    Int             // e.g. number of Serper queries or 1 per request
metadata    Json?          // for AI_TOKENS: { provider, model, inputTokens, outputTokens
color       String        // gray, red, amber, green, blue, violet
key              String             // FREE, BASIC, PRO, BUSINESS, SCALE, etc.
representativeId      String?                // ligado a um representante comercial
representative Representative?  fields: [representativeId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
ipHash      String?  // hash do IP para métricas (opcional)
availableAt    DateTime  // vira pagável após hold
resendApiKeyEncrypted  String?  // cifrado; só quando provider = resend
smtpPasswordEncrypted  String?  // cifrado; só quando provider = smtp
oldValue     String?       // e.g. "NEW" for status change, "45" for score change
metadata     Json?         // Extra: { reason, dealValue, note, tagLabel, crmProvider
briefDate    DateTime      // One per day per workspace
recommendations Json                // Array of { leadId, leadName, reason, priority, suggestedAction
body        Json                // { paragraphs, benefits, badge, badgeColor, subtitle, legalNote, expiresAt, accentColor
audienceFilter  Json?                 // { plans, inactiveDays, minDaysSinceSignup, cities
description String                      // "Atividades de consultoria em gestão empresarial"
cnaePrincipal String       // CNAE fiscal principal (7 dígitos)
// Blacklist de CNPJs que nunca devem ser contatados
workspaceId   String?   // null → perfil do sistema (visível para todos)
priority      Int       // ordem de execução (menor = primeiro)
openedAfter   String?   // Data mínima de abertura YYYYMMDD
// Dados da empresa (espelho desnormalizado do RfCompany)
dailyLimit            Int      // limite de envios/dia por remetente
sentToday             Int        // resetado pelo cron diário
/** Which gateway sends/receives for this rep: EVOLUTION (QR-paired personal number) or META (official Cloud API). */
/** Meta WhatsApp Cloud API phone_number_id, registered externally in Meta Business Suite. */
/** Owner: exactly one of representativeId / adminConfigId is set today; workspaceId is reserved for customer rollout. */
